subject.title: [Feature]: Add X-Actual-Model header to expose runtime model in HTTP responses

question: What actual-runtime-model contract should Gateway expose for non-streaming and streaming OpenAI-compatible HTTP responses?
rationale: Current code has selected-model metadata below the HTTP layer, but normal response headers are flushed too early for streaming fallback cases; maintainers need to choose the public API shape before implementation.

options.title: Define unified metadata contract
options.body: Document and implement one additive contract for non-streaming body/header metadata plus streaming SSE-compatible metadata across Chat Completions and Responses.

options.title: Limit to non-streaming headers
options.body: Add a response header only where the selected model is known before headers are sent, while leaving streaming clients for a separate follow-up contract.

options.title: Defer transport metadata
options.body: Keep HTTP responses unchanged and route model transparency through broader session/runtime resolved-model work instead.

recommendation.title: Define unified metadata contract
recommendation.body: Document and implement one additive contract for non-streaming body/header metadata plus streaming SSE-compatible metadata across Chat Completions and Responses.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this exact Gateway API-contract gap and has the strongest recent owner signal for the affected endpoint/docs surface.
